Method of Attack: First-stage malware executed on 32-bit platforms only, collected data about infected PCs
Data sent to remote C&C server storing info in MariaDB
Filters run on infected hosts to determine delivery of second-stage stealthy backdoor trojan
Impacted Systems: Networks of large technology firms including Google, Microsoft, HTC, Samsung, Intel, Sony, VMWare, O2, Vodafone, Linksys, Epson, MSI, Akamai, DLink, Oracle (Dyn), Gauselmann, Singtel
Attack Vector: Malicious CCleaner application binaries offered for download between August 15 and September 12
Infection via poisoned CCleaner and CCleaner Cloud binaries
Indicators of Compromise: Database entries of infected hosts (700,000 first-stage, 20 second-stage)
Timeline of server installation and data collection from July 31 to September 16, 2017
